title: Dave Dorman
description: DAVE DORMAN is one of the latest in a long line of comic artists to draw the STAR WARS pantheon, as shown in this cover (front), one of six from the Dark Horse Comics limited series, "Dark Empire." Who could be more appropriate to announce the National Public Radio STAR WARS series than C-3PO with earset and microphone (back) in this painting by Celia Strain. The series included many parts of the saga that never appeared on screen.
